note: Hand-authored. Subject replies to every message within ~1-3 minutes; observer also replies quickly. Ground truth: fast replier.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: are you free to look at the lease this afternoon?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: yes, send me the address and I will be there at half past two

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: I have put a pin on the map, it is the shop with the green sign

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: found it, I can see the shop from here actually, I will come in now

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: no rush, they are open until six

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I am being served now, the lease is on the counter, one moment

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: take your time, I will wait nearby

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: all done, it was fine, they have a new one ready to sign

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: can you confirm the pickup time for tomorrow

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: yes, seven in the morning, they said they will be there by quarter past

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: great, I will be waiting by the kerb

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: ok, I will text you when I set off so you know the timing

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: perfect, that works

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: will do, I am putting the keys in the door now so I do not forget them

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: did the plumber turn up about the radiator

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: yes, he came at four and it is bleeding now, he said it needed a full flush

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: that is good news, how much did he charge

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: eighty pounds, he did not charge for the parts because he had them on the van

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: good, I will transfer you tonight

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: no need, treat it as a thank you for the coffee last week

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: can you let me know if the survey goes ahead on thursday

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: will do, they are coming at ten so I will know straight away

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: thanks, I need to be out by noon

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: no problem, I will text you the moment they arrive

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: appreciate it

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: anytime, I will keep you posted either way
